matchHelpHost.message: Matches only this exact hostname and port. A different subdomain will not match.

matchHelpStartsWith.message: Matches any page on the same site as this address — the scheme and host must be identical, so a lookalike domain such as example.com.attacker.com will never match even though it starts with the same text. Within that same site, this can still match more than intended: example.com/app also matches example.com/app-legacy, since both begin the same way.

matchHelpExact.message: Matches only this exact page address, including its path and query.

matchHelpNever.message: Hides this entry from the browser extension only — it stays fully visible and usable inside MyPass.
